Event Dates: From Jan 17, 2026 to Jan 18, 2026
Entry Deadline: Dec 15, 2025
Details:

Tournament Dates: January 17-19, 2026

This event will be for 2012 – 2018 birth year players.

2018- 2016 Birth year will play 7 v 7
2015-2014 Birth year will play 9 v 9
2013-2012 Birth year will play 11 v 11

All teams are guaranteed 3-games.

Games will be played at Surf Sports Park, Del Mar, CA.

This is a Class I Tournament open to USYS, US Club Soccer, USSSA and FIFA-affiliated teams.

This event is sanctioned by US Club Soccer, and ALL players must have 2025/2026 player cards to participate.

The registration deadline is December 12, 2025 at midnight. Teams will be notified of their acceptance for the event by December 20, 2025.

This is a Stay and Play event. Your team must be accepted before reserving any room blocks.

For hotel inquiries please contact Athlete Travel, [email protected]
